report_comment.text: KIF5B encodes a kinesin motor protein that transports cargo along microtubules. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. KIF5B exon20 fused to ALK exon20 was documented in a lung adenocarcinoma. In the reported patient, crizotinib produced a partial response followed by progression and detection of ALK L1196M. ALK-directed treatment is supported by the ALK-positive NSCLC indication; the cited evidence for this particular partner is a case report.
